title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1

Article 9 (Detailed Rules for Enforcement)
Matters necessary for the acquisition of private investments, other than those prescribed in this Decree, shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Prime Minister. [Amended on February 29, 2008.]
